tactics: exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at h))
rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk <;> simp_all [Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right]
have hk : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at h)

cases k with
  | zero => simp at h
  | succ k => rw [Nat.mul_succ]; omega
